title: Swap and Sort
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2\leq N \leq 1000; P is a permutation of (1,2,\ldots,N).; 1\leq M \leq \min(2\times 10^5, \frac{N(N-1)}{2}); 1\leq a_i \lt b_i\leq N; (a_i,b_i)\neq (a_j,b_j) if i\neq j.; All values in input are integers.
